proofClass: analytic coercive-form replacement with fail-closed imported premises

scope.galerkinSpaces: nested finite spans of an a_rep-orthonormal basis of H_rep
scope.deltaDefinition: lambda_min^+(E*E)/2 when E*E is nonzero; otherwise 1

originalCounterexampleAcknowledgedStatus.label: original endpoint-B nonnegativity obstruction is acknowledged
originalCounterexampleAcknowledgedStatus.reason: The replacement is enabled only after importing the certified smooth N_0 negative direction.

augmentedCoerciveFormStatus.label: H8-augmented endpoint-B form is positive, coercive, and closed
augmentedCoerciveFormStatus.reason: Adding (1+||K_B||_HS)||f||_2^2 and derivative energies through order eight dominates the bounded signed kernel form and gives a norm equivalent to H8.

closedMovingTraceStatus.label: moving eighth-order trace is bounded with closed kernel
closedMovingTraceStatus.reason: The normalized eigenrow Cauchy-Schwarz estimate bounds R:H8->L2(I); therefore ker R and its finite-codimensional high block are closed.

nonvacuousHighBlockStatus.label: the augmented closed-trace high block is infinite-dimensional
nonvacuousHighBlockStatus.reason: Smooth functions supported in the exterior interval (0.545,L) lie in ker R; intersecting this infinite-dimensional subspace with the orthogonal complement of finite-dimensional F_M leaves an infinite-dimensional subspace.

compactLipschitzSourceStatus.label: special source family is finite-rank, compact, and norm-Lipschitz
compactLipschitzSourceStatus.reason: The source rows use only the fixed jets D^j f(s0), 0<=j<=7. H8 trace boundedness and analytic source coefficients give uniform/Lipschitz Riesz rows; their range lies in the span of eight boundary coefficient functions and one evaluation coefficient function.

intrinsicMoscoStatus.label: intrinsic conforming Galerkin exhaustion is Mosco convergent
intrinsicMoscoStatus.reason: Finite spans of an orthonormal basis of the closed augmented high block are nested and dense, giving Mosco limsup and liminf and strong projection convergence.

sourceOperatorNormConsistencyStatus.label: compressed source operators converge in norm
sourceOperatorNormConsistencyStatus.reason: Strong Galerkin projections converge uniformly after composition with the finite-rank source operator.

adaptiveExactSpectralGapStatus.label: replacement delta lies in an exact source spectral gap
adaptiveExactSpectralGapStatus.reason: For nonzero finite-rank S=E*E use delta_rep=lambda_min^+(S)/2; if S=0 use delta_rep=1. In either case delta_rep is in the resolvent.

continuumQDeltaIdentificationStatus.label: replacement Galerkin Q_delta converges to the continuum projection
continuumQDeltaIdentificationStatus.reason: Norm convergence of the finite-rank compressions and the exact adaptive gap give norm convergence of the Riesz projections.

exactEndpointFlowStatus.label: exact continuous endpoint right inverse remains available
exactEndpointFlowStatus.reason: Imported from the exact residual/tail global boundary-value Krawczyk certificate.

nonImplication: Closure of this replacement does not prove positivity of the original endpoint-B form and does not restore the original Weyl/KLM or RH claim.
